channel.title: Crochet Baby Gifts
channel.description: Size charts, yarn guides and gifting advice for handmade baby gifts.

item.title: What to Write on a Handmade Baby Gift Tag
item.description: How to write a gift tag for a handmade baby present — the three things it must carry, why the care line matters most, and wording to borrow when nothing comes to mind.

item.title: Crochet Rose Car Charm: Free Pattern for Your Rearview Mirror
item.description: Our own free pattern for a crochet rose car charm: one rolled rose, a rosebud and two leaves on a slip-stitch cord that hangs from the mirror with a lark's head knot. Stitch counts for every row, sizes, and a free printable PDF.

item.title: Baby Mandrake Crochet: A Step-by-Step Project Guide
item.description: Follow the Baby Mandrake build with clear round tables, assembly checkpoints and yarn planning. Adapted from Mrs. Crowlet's pattern, with designer credit.

item.title: How to Present a Handmade Baby Blanket as a Gift
item.description: How to wrap, label and hand over a handmade baby blanket so it gets used rather than stored — including the one sentence on the tag that removes the recipient's biggest hesitation.

item.title: Sunflower Crochet Bunny: A Project Planner for Yarn, Colour and Finishing
item.description: Plan a sunflower crochet bunny with a yarn checklist, three colour recipes, ear comparison tips and finishing checks. Includes links to designers’ bunny patterns.

item.title: Easy Crochet Baby Hat for Beginners: Free Pattern in 5 Sizes, Preemie to 12 Months
item.description: A top-down half double crochet baby hat in five sizes, preemie to 12 months: the stitch count for every round, a lay-flat width check before the sides, and a stretchy ribbed brim. Worsted yarn, 50 to 125 yards.

item.title: How Long Does It Take to Crochet a Baby Blanket?
item.description: Realistic hours to crochet a baby blanket by size, yarn weight and stitch, how to work out your own speed in ten minutes, and how far ahead of a due date to start.

item.title: How to Store Handmade Baby Keepsakes So They Last
item.description: How to store a handmade baby blanket or first booties for decades — what actually destroys textiles in storage, why the plastic box in the loft is the worst option, and a method that costs almost nothing.

item.title: Baby Bootie Size Chart: Sole Length by Age
item.description: Sole length in inches and centimetres by age for handmade baby booties, how to measure a foot that will not hold still, and the two design features that decide whether booties stay on.

item.title: How to Crochet a Baby Blanket for Beginners: Free Pattern in Every Size
item.description: Your first crochet baby blanket in half double crochet, step by step: how many to chain from one swatch, the same stitch count on every row, a single crochet border counted for every side, and three checks before you frog uneven edges. Four sizes, three yarn weights.

item.title: Cotton vs Acrylic vs Bamboo Yarn for Baby Items
item.description: A straight comparison of the three most common baby yarns on warmth, breathability, washability, drape, cost and durability — and which one to choose for each specific item.

item.title: Easy Crochet Baby Booties in Four Sizes: A Round-by-Round Guide
item.description: Craft & Crochet's easy baby booties written out round by round for newborn, 0-3, 3-6 and 6-12 months: an oval half double crochet sole, a shaped toe and a straight ankle, with every stitch count and video timestamp.

item.title: Baby Hat Size Chart by Age (Preemie to 3 Years)
item.description: Head circumference and hat height by age for handmade baby hats, how much negative ease to use so the hat actually stays on, and why the age on the chart is the least reliable number in it.

item.title: Baby Blanket Color Combinations: Palettes That Work and How to Choose
item.description: Nine baby blanket colour palettes in one table, plus the checks most guides skip: will the stripes show, will the colours bleed, and what can a newborn see?

item.title: How to Crochet the Donatella Clutch: A Beginner-Friendly Tutorial
item.description: A step-by-step guide to Katy Handmade's Donatella crochet clutch: an oval base in single crochet, seven body rounds and a covered 19 cm spring closure, with video timestamps for every step.

item.title: Crochet T-Shirt Yarn Clutch Pattern: A Free Waistcoat-Stitch Clutch Built Around a 22 cm Snap Frame
item.description: A free crochet T-shirt yarn clutch pattern in waistcoat stitch, sized to a 22 cm clic-clac snap frame: a rectangular base worked in rounds, straight sides, and the frame crocheted into the top edge, with every stitch count worked out from gauge.

item.title: Machine-Washable Yarn for Baby Gifts: What to Look For
item.description: How to tell from a yarn label whether it will survive a real household wash — the four symbols that matter, what superwash actually means, and the words that mean the opposite of what you think.

item.title: Crochet Pencil Case Pattern: A Free Single-Crochet Zipper Case in Three Sizes
item.description: A free crochet pencil case pattern worked as one single-crochet rectangle: three sizes with exact zipper lengths, finished sizes and yarn estimates, plus the two steps that decide whether it comes out neat.

item.title: Yarn Weight Chart for Baby Projects (0–7, and What Each One Is Good For)
item.description: The full standard yarn weight system from lace to jumbo, with the hook size and gauge for each — and which weights actually suit baby blankets, hats, booties and toys.

item.title: What to Give at a Baby Shower When You Can't Crochet
item.description: How to give a handmade-feeling baby shower gift without making one — what new parents actually run out of, what gets quietly returned, and how to make a bought gift feel personal.

item.title: The Best Yarn for Baby Blankets: Soft, Washable and Safe
item.description: How to choose yarn for a baby blanket — the four properties that actually matter, what each fibre does in a wash, and why the softest yarn in the shop is often the wrong answer.

item.title: Is Acrylic Yarn Safe for Babies? An Honest Answer
item.description: Whether acrylic yarn is safe for baby blankets and clothes — the flammability question nobody addresses, the softness myth, and where the real concerns actually lie.

item.title: How to Wash a Crochet Baby Blanket Without Ruining It
item.description: How to wash a handmade crochet baby blanket by fibre — machine settings, what stretches it, how to dry it flat, and the two mistakes that cause permanent damage.

item.title: How Much Yarn for a Baby Blanket? Yardage by Size and Yarn Weight
item.description: Estimate yarn for a crochet baby blanket by size, yarn weight and stitch — with the square-inch method that lets you work out any size yourself, not just the ones on the chart.

item.title: Crochet or Knit for Baby Gifts? How to Choose
item.description: The real differences between crochet and knitting for baby items — speed, fabric, stretch, yarn use and which is easier to learn — with a straight recommendation for each project.

item.title: Crochet Hook Size Chart: US, UK and Metric Conversions
item.description: Every crochet hook size converted between metric, US letter-number and old UK numbering — plus why the US letters are not reliable and the millimetre figure is the only one to trust.

item.title: Crochet Baby Blanket Size Chart: Every Size, Newborn to Toddler
item.description: The standard crochet baby blanket sizes in inches and centimetres, from preemie to toddler — plus the one measurement that actually matters and why the charts disagree.

item.title: Are Crochet Blankets Safe for Babies to Sleep With?
item.description: The direct answer on crochet blankets and infant sleep, what current safe-sleep guidance actually says, and how to give a handmade blanket that gets used safely.
